backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, coaching topics, goals, session history, and availability management with role-based access control (admin/user permissions) using AccessControl and MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented authentication features: adding a login button to the Header, connecting it to Internet Identity authentication, and conditionally showing/hiding login/logout controls based on auth state.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components (Header with login button, CoachingDashboard, VoiceRecorder, etc.), hooks (useQueries, useVoiceRecording), pages, and configuration files for the AI coaching application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'AI Coach Voice - Your 24/7 Personal Coach' and meta description for the coaching application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component setting up TanStack Router with routes for home and coaching session pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with Layout containing Header, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AvailabilityIndi: Badge component displaying real-time 24/7 availability status with animated pulsing indicator, fetching data from backend via useGetAvailability hook.
frontend/src/components/CoachingDashboar: Main dashboard with prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button at top, hero section, quick-start topic cards, and recent session history with loading states and navigation to session pages.
frontend/src/components/CoachingInput.ts: Combined input component with text input field, send button, and voice recording toggle that switches between text and voice input modes for coaching interactions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution link with UTM tracking parameters based on current hostname.
frontend/src/components/GoalCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual coaching goal with topic, progress bar, completion percentage, and remove button using useRemoveGoal mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main application header component with navigation, authentication controls (Internet Identity login/logout), theme toggle, and availability indicator.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Chat message bubble component that displays messages with avatars, styling differently for coach vs user messages, and optional timestamps.
frontend/src/components/QuickStartCard.t: Card component for starting a coaching session on a specific topic, with loading state and navigation to the session page.
frontend/src/components/SessionCard.tsx: Simple card component that displays a coaching session with an icon and session name.
frontend/src/components/VoiceRecorder.ts: Voice recording component with controls for recording, playing back, and deleting audio recordings, including duration display and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend data fetching and mutations including availability, coaching topics, session history, goals management, and session operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceRecording.ts: Custom hook for managing voice recording state and operations including recording, playback, duration tracking, and audio cleanup using MediaRecorder API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components (primary, secondary, accent, destructive, success, sidebar, etc.) and custom animations (pulse-ring, slide-up).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/CoachingSessionPage.t: Real-time coaching session page with message chat interface, voice message support, goal tracking, and AI coach responses. Handles user authentication, message history, and goal management for a specific coaching topic.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page that displays marketing content with features (24/7 availability, voice enabled, goal tracking) and login CTA for unauthenticated users, or shows CoachingDashboard for authenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and keyframe animations for accordion and pulse effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features for an AI coaching application, including voice recording, coaching dashboard, real-time chat interface, 24/7 availability, and known issues with button visibility and login access.
